Connection & Isolation

New. Born from the ambient noise of the Paradise servers themselves — worshipped quietly by New Veracruz dock workers and server technicians who spend too many hours listening to the uploaded dead hum. Offers comfort, company, and the sense of being heard; delivers exactly that, and nothing more, ever again.
